blocks.text: Scheduling automation that eliminates the back-and-forth

Calendly solved the "when are you free?" problem so well that it became a category-defining product. Share a link, let people pick a time that works, and the meeting appears on both calendars - no email ping-pong required.

For sales and revenue teams, Calendly's routing and qualification features go beyond basic scheduling. Prospects can answer qualifying questions before booking, then get automatically routed to the right rep based on company size, location, or product interest. This pre-qualification means sales reps spend time with qualified leads rather than discovery calls.

The enterprise features - SSO, SCIM provisioning, admin controls, and compliance certifications - make Calendly suitable for organizations with strict security requirements. It scales from individual freelancers to Fortune 500 sales teams without switching platforms.
Let prospects choose who to meet with from a team page
Pre-booking questions that route to the right team member
Automated reminders, follow-ups, and post-meeting actions
Meeting funnel analytics and conversion tracking
Two-way sync with Google Calendar, Outlook, and iCloud
Calendly remains the most polished and widely recognized scheduling tool. For client-facing bookings where brand perception matters, Calendly's professional experience builds trust.
Our team can integrate Calendly into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
